title: Change Order Tariff for Commission Specifications
content:
# Change Order Tariff for Commission Specifications

Under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions a change to the specification after the design has been approved is governed by three programme figures: the calendar days after design approval within which a change may still be agreed, the administration fee charged on each agreed change, and how many changes may be agreed on one commission.

## Tariff

| Programme | Change window after design approval (calendar days) | Administration fee per agreed change | Changes that may be agreed on one commission |
|---|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 7 | USD 95.00 | 1 |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 10 | USD 150.00 | 2 |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 14 | USD 275.00 | 3 |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 21 | USD 450.00 | 3 |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 14 | USD 325.00 | 3 |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 30 | USD 950.00 | 5 |

## Selection case (hypothetical)

A Design Studio Custom Setting commission allows 2 agreed changes in all, each carrying an administration fee of USD 150.00, and a change may be agreed within 10 calendar days of the design being approved. A Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission allows 5, at USD 950.00 each, within 30 calendar days.

## Reading the tariff

The fee is a per-change amount, charged on each agreed change; the count is a ceiling on agreed changes over the whole commission; the window is counted from the date the customer approved the design.
